name: io.github.sjwilliams8/compliance-suite
description: OFAC sanctions screening and FDIC bank verification. $0.01 per call in USDC, no API key.

environmentVariables.name: TOLLBOOTH_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a Base wallet funded with USDC. This is how calls are paid for; each call costs $0.01. Required unless you set the CDP_* variables instead.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_API_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Coinbase CDP API key ID. Set CDP_API_KEY_ID, CDP_API_KEY_SECRET and CDP_WALLET_SECRET together to pay from a CDP server wallet instead of a raw private key, leaving TOLLBOOTH_PRIVATE_KEY blank.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_API_KEY_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Coinbase CDP API key secret. Needed only when paying from a CDP server wallet.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_WALLET_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Coinbase CDP wallet secret. Needed only when paying from a CDP server wallet.

environmentVariables.name: TOLLBOOTH_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Which network to pay on: "base" (mainnet, real USDC) or "base-sepolia" (testnet, faucet USDC, same data). Defaults to base.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_ACCOUNT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Which named Coinbase CDP account to pay from, when using a CDP server wallet. If your funds sit in a named account and this is unset, payments are signed by the default account and rejected as unfunded.

environmentVariables.name: TOLLBOOTH_MAX_PRICE
environmentVariables.description: Refuse to pay more than this for a single call, e.g. "$0.02". Defaults to $0.05. Guards against a mispriced or spoofed payment challenge.
